spans.s: (mc. for रेखा, fr. √ रिख् = लिख्) a scratch, line, Caurap.
N. of a man g. शिवादि
See below.
a scratch, streak, stripe, line, Gṛhyās.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
a continuous line, row, range, series, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
the first or prime meridian (considered to be a line drawn from Laṅkā to Meru i.e. from Ceylon [supposed to lie on the equator] to the north pole), Sūryas.
a right or straight position of all the limbs in dancing, Saṃgīt.
delineation, outline, drawing, sketch, Kāv.; Kathās.
appearance (रेखया ifc. under the app˚ of Bālar.; रेखां न-√ लभ्, not to attain even to the app˚ of, not to be at all equal to, Vcar.)
deceit, fraud (= छद्मन्), L.
fulness, satisfaction (= आभोग), L.
a small quantity, little portion, L. (cf. -मात्रम्).
See बिन्दु-र्˚.
रेखा˚ंश (रेखांश). m. a degree of longitude, L.
रेखा˚कार (रेखाक्˚) mfn. formed in lines, striped, MW.
रेखा—गणित n. ‘line-reckoning, geometry’, N. of a wk. by Bhāskarācārya
रेखा—गणित—क्षेत्र-व्यवहार m. ‘geometry and mensuration’, N. of a wk. by Jagan-nātha (18th century).
रेखा—जातक-सुधाकर m. N. of wk. (on prognostications from lines on various parts of the body).
रेखा˚न्तर (रेखान्त्˚) n. geographical longitude, distance east or west from the first meridian, L.
रेखा—न्यास m. the marking down of lines or lineaments, outline, sketch, Kāv.
रेखा—प्रतीति f.
रेखा—प्रदीप m. N. of astron. works.
रेखा—मात्रम् ind. even by a line or by a hair's breadth, Ragh.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, g. कण्ड्व्-आदि.
patr. (also pl.), Saṃskārak.
having lines on the hand, lined (बहु-र्˚), VarBṛS.
